questions.label: What should the agent do?
questions.hint: One or two sentences. Do not enter secrets, keys or customer data.

questions.label: Which actions can the agent trigger?
Does the agent have write access to any system?
When does a human approve an action?
Are there hard limits on amounts or volume per action and per day?
Which identity does the agent use to call tools?
options: Its own identity with scoped permissions

questions.label: Can you stop the agent and revoke its access within minutes?
Is every action logged with who, what and why?
Do you get alerts on unusual agent behavior?
Is one person accountable for agent incidents?
What untrusted content can reach the agent?
options: Outputs of other tools or agents

questions.label: Is untrusted content isolated from the agent's instructions and tools?
Can the agent chain several tools or agents in one task?
